7  So they got up and fled in the dusk
items.contrast: The fleeing Arameans versus the people who approached the Aramean camp.
items.reason: The repeated pronoun could initially be confused with the people arriving in verse 5, but the intervening clause identifies the Arameans as those who heard the army, feared an attack, and consequently fled. Resolving that change in pronoun reference is a meaningful actor distinction.
